blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World-action models jointly predict future observations and actions, yet visual corruption can disrupt the resulting policies. We introduce HOG-WAM, which adds future Histograms of Oriented Gradients (HOG) as structural supervision derived directly from demonstration images. An auxiliary HOG diffusion transformer (DiT) module reads RGB features through asymmetric attention, allowing its objective to shape the visual representation used for control. The module is used only during training and removed at inference, preserving FastWAM's RGB-to-action architecture. We evaluate four controlled observation corruptions through a visual-corruption extension of RoboTwin, termed RoboTwin-Plus; HOG-WAM achieves the highest success among the compared policies under all four. Mixed-noise success increases from 78.86% to 82.86% relative to FastWAM, with comparable performance on clean scenes. On LIBERO Plus, overall success increases from 74.49% to 75.26%, with the largest gain under sensor noise, from 74.14% to 78.89%. Across four Franka tasks, average success increases from 40% to 59% under clean observations and from 17% to 24% under noisy observations. A representation ablation favors combining RGB observations with auxiliary HOG prediction over replacing RGB with HOG. These findings support future-gradient prediction as complementary supervision for visually robust control, with larger absolute gains on physical tasks than in simulation. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/HOG-WAM.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Robotic manipulation requires recognizing task-relevant objects and anticipating how their spatial relations change during interaction.
Vision-language-action policies use pretrained visual and language representations to map observations to actions [ 40 , 17 , 5 ] .
World-action models (WAMs) additionally learn to predict future observations, making demonstrated scene evolution a source of policy supervision [ 35 , 18 , 3 ] .
Fast-WAM [ 38 ] , denoted FastWAM here, preserves this predictive objective during training while generating actions from the current observation at inference.
The prediction target therefore determines which visual information this training objective emphasizes.
blocks.zh:
机器人操纵需要识别与任务相关的物体并预测它们在相互作用过程中的空间关系如何变化。
愿景-语言行动政策使用经过预先培训的视觉和语言表现,将观测结果映射为行动[40、17、5]。
世界行动模型(WAMs)还学习预测未来的观测,使所展示的场景演变成为政策监督的来源[35、18、3].
快速WAM [38],表示 FastWAM在此,在训练期间保留了这一预测性目标,同时从目前推断的观察中产生出行动.
因此,预测目标决定了这一培训目标强调哪些视觉信息。

blocks.en:
RGB prediction supervises object structure together with color, texture, and illumination.
These appearance cues help identify objects, but they also vary with lighting and sensor conditions while the manipulation goal remains unchanged.
An RGB objective alone thus ties the learned features to appearance factors that can change at deployment.
For placement, stacking, and insertion, local boundaries describe the image-space arrangement of objects and their surroundings.
Requiring a visual representation to predict these boundaries provides an explicit structural learning signal alongside RGB reconstruction.
The question is how to introduce this signal while retaining the appearance information needed for language-conditioned control.
blocks.zh:
RGB预测将对象结构与颜色,纹理,和发光一起监督.
这些外观提示有助于识别出物体,但也会随着照明和传感器条件的不同而变化,而操纵目标不变.
因此,仅一个RGB目标就把所学到的特征与部署时可以改变的外观因素联系起来。
对于放置、堆放和插入,局部边界描述物体及其周围的图像-空间安排。
需要视觉表现来预测这些边界,在RGB重建的同时提供明确的结构学习信号.
问题是如何在保留语言条件化控制所需的外观信息的同时引入这个信号.

blocks.en:
Histograms of Oriented Gradients (HOG) [ 10 ] summarize local edge orientations through spatial pooling and contrast normalization.
MaskFeat [ 30 ] demonstrates that predicting HOG features in masked image and video regions can learn useful visual representations, identifying local contrast normalization as an important component.
This motivates a different prediction problem for manipulation: learning the gradient structure of future demonstration frames alongside actions.
The target emphasizes where local intensity transitions occur and how they are oriented, making spatial organization explicit without object annotations or a learned target generator.
blocks.zh:
Oriented Gradients (HOG)[10]的直方图通过空间集合和对比正常化来总结出局部边缘取向.
MaskFeat [30] 表明,在被蒙蔽的图像和视频区域中预测HOG特征可以学习有用的视觉表现,将局部对比正常化确定为一个重要的组成部分.
这引发了对操纵的不同预测问题:学习未来演示框的梯度结构与动作.
目标强调局部强度过渡在哪里发生,以及它们如何取向,使空间组织明确,没有对象说明或学习到的目标生成器.

blocks.en:
A descriptor useful for supervising a representation need not replace its sensory input.
Our HOG raster compresses orientation statistics and removes chromatic information; RGB retains cues for object identity and instruction grounding.
WAM4D [ 19 ] offers a related architectural principle: future-depth supervision shapes the visual features used for control through a removable readout.
We apply this principle to deterministic gradient targets, which require no additional sensor or pretrained estimator.
In HOG-WAM , an auxiliary HOG diffusion transformer (DiT) reads RGB features through asymmetric attention, and its loss updates the RGB backbone.
Action prediction remains independent of HOG tokens, allowing the auxiliary module to be removed at inference while retaining its effect on the learned RGB representation.
blocks.zh:
用于监督一种表示的描述符不需要取代其感官输入.
我们的HOG光栅压缩方向统计并去除色相信息;RGB保留了对象身份和指令地平面的提示.
WAM4D [19]提供了相关的建筑原理:未来深度的监理通过可移动读取来塑造用于控制的视觉特征.
我们对确定梯度目标适用这一原则,这不需要额外的传感器或预先经过训练的估算器。
在HOG-WAM中,一个辅助的HOG扩散变压器(DIT)通过不对称的注意来读取RGB的特性,其损失更新了RGB主干线.
动作预测仍然独立于HOG符号,使得辅助模块可以在推断时被去掉,同时保留其对所学到的RGB代表的影响.

blocks.en:
We evaluate visual robustness on RoboTwin 2.0 [ 7 ] , LIBERO Plus [ 13 ] , and four Franka tasks.
RoboTwin-Plus denotes our visual-corruption extension of the existing RoboTwin evaluation, with fixed tasks and controlled changes to image inputs.
On LIBERO Plus, gains concentrate under sensor noise.
A LIBERO Plus ablation compares HOG as auxiliary supervision with HOG as a replacement for RGB.
The physical experiments show larger absolute gains over FastWAM than the simulation averages, extending the evidence to manipulation with real camera observations.
Our contributions are: • A deterministic future-gradient target that makes local structure an explicit supervision signal for world-action learning. • An asymmetric coupling of RGB, HOG, and action DiT modules that transfers this supervision to the visual backbone while preserving RGB-based inference. • Evidence from controlled visual-corruption tests and physical manipulation, together with a representation ablation that supports complementary HOG supervision over RGB replacement.
blocks.zh:
在RoboTwin 2.0 [7],LIBERO Plus [13] 和4个Franka任务上,我们评价视觉强性.
RoboTwin-Plus表示我们现有的RoboTwin评价的视觉腐败扩展,任务固定,图像输入有控制的改变.
在利伯罗 此外,收益集中在传感器噪音下。
一个利伯罗 Plus ablation 将HOG作为辅助监督与HOG作为RGB的替代.
物理实验显示,比起模拟平均值,FastWAM的绝对收益更大,用真实相机观测将证据扩展到了操纵.
我们的贡献是:确定未来的指标,使地方结构成为世界行动学习的明确监督信号。 一个不对称的RGB,HOG,以及动作DiT模块的耦合,在保留基于RGB的推论的同时,将这种监管转移到了视觉主干. 二. 支助 来自受控视觉腐败测试和物理操纵的证据,以及支持对RGB替换进行补充性HOG监督的表示衰减.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Transformers [ 29 , 11 ] provide token-based architectures for visual learning, while diffusion models [ 16 ] , latent diffusion [ 26 ] , and DiTs [ 25 ] support conditional image generation.
Flow matching [ 20 ] and rectified flow [ 22 ] learn velocity fields that transport noise toward data.
Diffusion Policy [ 9 ] applies conditional denoising to action sequences.
RT-1 and RT-2 [ 6 , 40 ] scale observation-to-action learning, while Octo and OpenVLA [ 14 , 17 ] provide generalist policies adaptable to new robot settings.
The π 0 \pi_{0} family [ 5 , 4 ] combines pretrained vision-language representations with continuous action generation and heterogeneous training data.
HOG-WAM instead studies how the visual prediction objective within a WAM can improve the representation used for control.
blocks.zh:
变形器[29,11]为视觉学习提供了以符号为基础的架构,而扩散模型[16],潜在扩散[26],而DiTs[25]则支持有条件的图像生成.
相匹配的流 [20] 并修正流 [22] 学习向数据传送噪声的速度字段.
传播政策[9]对动作序列适用有条件去名.
RT-1和RT-2[6,40]规模观测-行动学习,而Octo和OpenVLA[14,17]则提供可适应新机器人环境的通论政策.
家庭[5,4]将预先训练的视觉语言表述与持续的行动生成和多样化的培训数据结合起来。
HOG-WAM转而研究一个WAM中的视觉预测目标如何能改善用于控制的表现.

blocks.en:
UniPi [ 12 ] derives actions from text-conditioned video plans, and GR-1 [ 31 ] jointly predicts future images and actions after video pretraining.
Video foundation models such as Wan [ 27 ] supply visual dynamics priors for recent WAMs.
DreamZero [ 35 ] , LingBot-VA [ 18 ] , and MOTUS [ 3 ] couple visual dynamics and action generation through joint models.
FastWAM [ 38 ] separates future-video training from action inference.
Our auxiliary target builds on this separation, changing what the RGB representation is trained to predict.
blocks.zh:
UniPi [12] 从文本化的视频计划中获得动作,GR-1 [31] 在视频预训后共同预测未来的图像和行动.
Wan [27]等视频基础模型为近代WAM提供视觉动态前传.
DreamZero [35],LingBot-VA [18],和MOTUS [3]夫妇视觉动态和动作生成通过联合模型.
FastWAM [38] 将未来-视频训练与动作推论区分开来.
我们的辅助目标建立在这种分离的基础上,改变了RGB代表被训练来预测的内容.

blocks.en:
TesserAct [ 39 ] models RGB, depth, and normals, while Kinema4D [ 33 ] uses kinematic robot trajectories to condition RGB and point-map simulation.
WAM4D [ 19 ] transfers geometric priors through future-depth readouts that are removed at inference.
MaskWAM [ 36 ] uses mask prompting and prediction, FlowWAM [ 8 ] adopts optical flow as an action representation, and Robust-WAM [ 34 ] aligns action-stream features with semantic targets.
DreamWAM [ 37 ] combines appearance, motion, geometry, and semantics.
HOG-WAM complements these learned or task-specific targets with local gradient statistics computed directly from each demonstration frame.
blocks.zh:
Tesser Act [39] 型号为RGB,深度和常态;而Kinema4D [33] 则使用动能机器人轨迹来条件RGB和点-映射模拟.
WAM4D [19] 通过未来深度读取来传输几何前缀,在推论中被删除.
MaskWAM [36] 使用口罩提示和预测,FlowWAM [8] 采用光学流作为动作表现,而Robust-WAM [34] 将动作流特性与语义目标相协调.
DreamWAM [37]结合了外观,运动,几何,和语义.
HOG-WAM用从每个演示框架中直接计算的当地梯度统计数据来补充这些已学到的或特定任务的目标。

blocks.en:
The target representation determines the information emphasized by a predictive objective.
BEiT [ 2 ] predicts discrete visual tokens; MAE and SimMIM [ 15 , 32 ] reconstruct pixels; VideoMAE [ 28 ] extends masked reconstruction to videos; and I-JEPA [ 1 ] predicts learned target embeddings.
MaskFeat [ 30 ] identifies HOG [ 10 ] as an effective feature-regression target, connecting local shape information with representation learning.
HOG-WAM carries this target-design insight into predictive robot learning: a HOG-derived raster is predicted in the video latent space alongside future RGB and actions.
The structural predictor is an auxiliary training objective, while the policy retains RGB observations for control.
blocks.zh:
目标表述决定了预测目标所强调的信息。
BeiT [2] 预测离散的视觉符号;MAE和SimMIM [15,32] 重建像素;VideoMAE [28] 将蒙面重建扩展到视频;而I-JEPA [1] 预测所学出的目标嵌入.
MaskFeat [30] 将HOG [10] 确定为有效的特征后退目标,将本地形状信息与代表学习相连接.
HOG-WAM载有预测机器人学习的这种目标设计洞察力:在视频潜在空间中,与未来的RGB和行动一起,预测出一个HOG衍生光栅.
结构预测器是一个辅助训练目标,而政策保留了RGB的观察来控制.

During training, the model contains RGB, HOG, and action DiT modules.
The HOG DiT shares the pretrained initialization of the RGB DiT and has independently optimized parameters.
Each module embeds its noisy state and flow time, with asymmetric mixed attention coupling the streams at every layer.
The RGB and HOG heads predict velocities in the video latent space, and the action head predicts velocities in normalized action coordinates.
Visual latents are divided into 1 × 2 × 2 1\times 2\times 2 spatiotemporal patches.
The visual and action DiTs use different hidden widths but project their queries, keys, and values to a common attention-head geometry.
Separate feature transformations and output heads preserve each modality’s prediction objective.

RGB queries attend to RGB keys, while HOG queries attend to both RGB and HOG keys.
These visual connections follow a first-frame-causal rule: observed-frame queries use observed-frame keys, whereas future queries can use the observed frame and all noisy future frames.
Action queries attend to the observed RGB frame and their own action chunk, with independently sampled action copies kept separate.
All three DiT modules additionally receive language and proprioceptive context through cross-attention.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
We test whether future-gradient supervision improves control under visual corruption and whether it is more effective as an auxiliary target than as an RGB replacement.
Simulation benchmarks assess controlled visual and task variations; four Franka tasks assess physical manipulation.
blocks.zh:
我们检验未来级监督是否改善视觉腐败下的控制,以及它作为辅助目标是否比RGB替代更有效.
模拟基准评估受控的视觉和任务变化;四个弗兰卡任务评估物理操纵.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en:
FastWAM provides the RGB–action baseline; HOG-WAM adds an auxiliary HOG DiT module during training.
Both policies condition actions on RGB observations, language instructions, and proprioception.
We train a separate pair of policies for each benchmark, using the same demonstration collection within each pair.
We report success rate (SR) using each benchmark’s task-completion criterion.
blocks.zh:
FastWAM提供RGB–动作基线;HOG-WAM在训练期间会添加一个辅助HOG DIT模块.
这两项政策都以RGB观察、语言指示和自主性作为行动的条件。
我们为每个基准单独培训一对政策,使用每对基准中相同的示范收集。
我们使用每个基准的任务完成标准报告成功率。

blocks.en:
On RoboTwin, both policies use 27,500 demonstrations across 50 tasks, with 50 clean and 500 randomized demonstrations per task.
A trajectory-level split assigns 27,225 demonstrations to training and 275 to validation; both policies are evaluated at step 29,365.
We also include the released RoboTwin-adapted π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 4 , 24 ] and MOTUS [ 3 , 23 ] policies as additional baselines.
All four models are evaluated on all 50 tasks, with 100 valid episodes per task in each of six conditions: clean, randomized, and the four corruptions defined in Sec. 4.2 .
For LIBERO, FastWAM and HOG-WAM use the same 2,000 demonstrations spanning 40 tasks from the Spatial, Object, Goal, and LIBERO-10 suites [ 21 ] .
We evaluate both policies on the same 10,030 LIBERO Plus variants, using one rollout per variant from the first official initial state [ 13 ] .
This benchmark includes changes in background, lighting, sensor noise, camera viewpoint, language, object layout, and robot initialization.

blocks.en: 4.2 Visual-corruption testing on RoboTwin
blocks.zh: 4.2 在RoboTwin进行视觉腐败测试

blocks.en:
RoboTwin 2.0 [ 7 ] supplies native clean and randomized scene settings.
We extend its clean-scene evaluation with four image corruptions: mixed noise, warm filtering, underexposure, and reduced contrast.
We use RoboTwin-Plus as shorthand for this visual-corruption test, which retains the original tasks, scenes, and success criteria.
Each operator acts on the policy’s RGB inputs before visual encoding, leaving the task, language, and proprioceptive inputs unchanged.
The RoboTwin-Plus score averages success over the four corruption conditions.
Native clean and randomized results are reported separately.
blocks.zh:
RoboTwin 2.0 [7] 提供本土清洁和随机的场景设置.
我们扩展了它的清洁场景评价,包括四种形象腐败:混合噪音、取暖过滤、曝光不足和缩小对比。
我们用RoboTwin-Plus作为这个视觉腐败测试的简称,它保留了最初的任务,场景,以及成功的标准.
每个操作员在进行视觉编码之前先根据策略的 RGB 输入进行操作,使任务、语言和自動输入保持不变。
RoboTwin-Plus得分平均比四项腐败条件成功.
原生的清洁和随机结果分别报告.

blocks.en:
HOG-WAM achieves the highest success among the four policies in every RoboTwin-Plus condition ( Tab. 1 ).
The gain concentrates under mixed noise, which causes the largest reduction in FastWAM success.
HOG-WAM also improves success under all three photometric corruptions.

HOG-WAM在每个RoboTwin-Plus条件下的四项政策中取得了最大的成功(图一.
收益集中在混杂的噪音下,这导致FastWAM的成功减少最大.

blocks.en:
Under mixed noise, HOG-WAM is higher than FastWAM on 28 of the 50 tasks, tied on 6, and lower on 16.
Gains are pronounced for block handover and placing bottles in a dustbin, while success is lower when placing a can in a basket or placing a shoe.
Under the photometric conditions, improved and lowered tasks are closer to balanced, in line with the small average differences.
blocks.zh:
在混合噪声下,HOG-WAM在50个任务中,28个任务比FastWAM高,6个被捆绑,16个更低.
收益用于块状移交和将瓶子放入灰盒,而将罐子放入篮子或放入鞋时,成功率较低.
在测光条件下,根据较小的平均差异,改进和降低的任务更接近平衡。

blocks.en: 4.3 Robustness on LIBERO Plus
blocks.zh: 4.3 利贝罗加的强力

blocks.en:
The effect of HOG supervision on LIBERO Plus is category-specific ( Tab. 2 ).
HOG-WAM gains most under sensor noise and camera viewpoint changes and is lower under background and lighting changes; robot initialization, language, and object layout differ by less than 0.3 points.
A paired bootstrap over source tasks gives a 95% interval for the difference that excludes zero only for sensor noise.
By source suite, HOG-WAM has higher success on Object and Spatial, with the largest gain in Object; FastWAM is slightly higher on Goal and LIBERO-10 ( Tab. 3 ).
blocks.zh:
HOG监督对LIBERO Plus的影响是特定类别(表2.).
HOG-WAM在传感器噪声和相机视角变化下收益最大,在背景和照明变化下收益较低;机器人初始化,语言,和对象布局差异小于0.3分.
在源任务之上的一对靴子为差异设定了95%的间隔,其中只排除了传感器噪声的0.
根据源套件,HOG-WAM在Object和Space上取得了更高的成功,在Object上收获最大;FastWAM在Goal和LIBERO-10上略有提高(TAB. 3)。

blocks.en: 4.4 Real-world Franka manipulation
blocks.zh: 4.4 真实世界的Franka操纵

blocks.en:
We evaluate FastWAM and HOG-WAM on four Franka tasks: bracket reorientation, produce placement, block stacking, and cylinder insertion ( Fig. 4 ).
The collection contains 1,000 demonstrations, with 200 for each task except produce placement, which has 400.
Both policies use the same demonstrations, camera views, language instructions, and joint-position action representation.
We evaluate both models at training step 30,000.
blocks.zh:
我们评价FastWAM和HOG-WAM的四个Franka任务:调整括号、生产放置、块叠和气瓶插入(图4)。
该馆藏有1000个演示品,每个任务有200个,但产品投放除外,有400个.
这两项政策都使用相同的演示,相机取景,语言说明,以及联合定位行动代表.
我们评价两种模式的训练步骤30 000。

blocks.en:
The tasks require distinct final spatial relations: an inverted bracket, produce contained in a basket, a stable block stack, and a seated cylinder.
The policies observe a main-camera view and a wrist-camera view, together with measured joint positions and gripper width.
Demonstrations are recorded at 30 Hz and divided by trajectory into 900 training and 100 validation examples.
Both models use normalization statistics from the training trajectories and predict absolute joint targets with a binary gripper command.
Each trial lasts at most 200 steps and terminates early on success or a failure/error.
After every trial, the robot is reset using the reset command.
blocks.zh:
各项任务需要不同的最终空间关系:一个倒置的括号,一个篮子中包含的产物,一个稳定的块堆,和一个坐着的圆柱.
这些政策观测主相机和手腕相机,以及测量的联合位置和抓取器宽度。
示范记录为30赫兹并按轨迹分为900个培训和100个验证实例。
这两个模型都使用从训练轨迹中得出的常态统计,并以二进制抓取指令预测绝对联合目标.
每次审判最多200个步骤,并在成功或失败/错误时提前结束。
每次试验后,机器人都会使用重置指令来重置.

blocks.en: Each task includes 25 trials per model under clean observations and 25 under the RoboTwin-Plus mixed-noise condition, giving 400 physical trials overall. Table 4 reports task success rates and their macro-average.

HOG-WAM achieves higher success on all four tasks under clean observations.
The gain concentrates in block stacking; the other three tasks improve by two or three successes out of 25 trials.
Under noise, it retains an advantage in reorientation, placement, and stacking, while neither policy completes cylinder insertion.
blocks.zh:
HOG-WAM在清洁观测下的所有四项任务上都取得了更高的成功.
收益集中于块堆放;另外三项任务在25个试验中增加了两到三个成功。
在噪声下,它保留了方向调整、放置和堆放的优势,而政策中都没有完成气瓶插入。

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation study
blocks.zh: 4.5 读取研究

blocks.en:
We compare FastWAM, RGB-to-HOG, and HOG-WAM to distinguish auxiliary structural supervision from replacing RGB inputs and targets.
RGB-to-HOG converts observations to HOG during training and inference; its visual DiT predicts future HOG, while its action DiT predicts actions.
HOG-WAM retains RGB observations and RGB prediction, adding a separate HOG DiT for auxiliary supervision.
All configurations share the 2,000 LIBERO demonstrations, effective batch size, and optimization steps.
Evaluation uses the same 10,030 LIBERO Plus variants, initial states, and rollout settings.
blocks.zh:
我们比较FastWAM,RGB对HOG,和HOG-WAM,以区分辅助结构监督与替换RGB输入和目标.
RGB-to-HOG在训练和推断时会将观测结果转换为HOG;其视觉DiT预测未来HOG,而其动作DiT预测动作.
HOG-WAM保留了RGB观测和RGB预测,为辅助监督增加了单独的HOG DiT.
所有配置共享2000个LIBERO演示,有效的批量大小,以及优化步骤.

Auxiliary supervision yields the highest overall success among the three configurations ( Sec. 4.5 ).
Both RGB-input policies achieve higher success than RGB-to-HOG under viewpoint, noise, language, initial-state, and object-layout changes ( Sec. 4.5 ).
RGB-to-HOG leads under background and lighting changes, the two categories whose perturbations are confined to appearance that its input discards.

辅助监督在三个组合中取得了最高的总体成功(第4.5节)。
RGB-输入政策在观点,噪音,语言,初始状态,和对象放出变化(sec.4.5.)下都取得了比RGB-to-HOG更高的成功.
RGB-to-HOG在背景和照明变化下领先,其扰动仅限于其输入所抛弃的外观.

blocks.en:
The replacement model changes both the observation and the visual prediction problem.
Its compressed orientation statistics suppress appearance variation but also remove chromatic distinctions that can identify an instructed object.
HOG-WAM retains these cues in RGB, and its response to background and lighting changes stays close to the RGB-input baseline.
Auxiliary HOG supervision improves success under sensor noise and viewpoint changes while preserving the cues that RGB-to-HOG loses in the remaining categories.
Under sensor noise the ordering reverses: HOG computed from corrupted observations is the weakest input, whereas HOG computed from clean frames is an effective target.
The comparison favors separating the information presented to the policy from the target used to shape its representation.
blocks.zh:
替换模型既会改变观测,也会改变视觉预测问题.
其压缩取向统计抑制外观变异,但也去除可以识别被指示对象的色谱区分.
HOG-WAM在RGB中保留了这些提示,其对背景和照明变化的反应仍然接近RGB-输入基线.
辅助HOG监督在感官噪声和视角变化下提高了成功度,同时保留了RGB至HOG在剩余类别中失去的提示.
在传感器噪声下,命令反向: 从被破坏的观测中计算出来的HOG是最弱的输入,而从干净的框架中计算出来的HOG是一个有效的目标.
比较有利于将提交给政策的信息与用来确定政策代表性的目标分开。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
The experiments favor assigning gradients and RGB different roles: gradients structure the learning objective, while RGB preserves the information available to the policy.
The design combines MaskFeat’s use of HOG as a predictive target [ 30 ] with a removable structural readout in the manner of WAM4D [ 19 ] , obtaining the supervision from deterministic local image statistics.
Its gains concentrate under sensor noise and viewpoint changes.
blocks.zh:
实验倾向于指定梯度和RGB不同的角色:梯度构建了学习目标,而RGB则保留了策略可用的信息.
MaskFeat将HOG作为预测目标[30],
它的收益集中在感官噪音和视线变化下。

blocks.en:
The physical results extend the evidence beyond rendered observations, with larger absolute gains than the simulation averages.
Each domain uses its own demonstrations, so these results establish effectiveness in both simulation and physical manipulation.
The HOG DiT is removed at inference, so both policies execute the same architecture with the same parameter count, and the benefit resides in the trained RGB and action weights.
blocks.zh:
物理结果将证据扩展到了观测结果之外,其绝对收益大于模拟平均值。
每个域都使用自己的演示,因此这些结果在模拟和物理操纵中都确立了有效性.
HOG DiT在推论中被去除,因此两种政策都执行相同的架构,其参数计数相同,好处在于训练有素的RGB和动作权重.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
HOG-WAM adds deterministic future-gradient supervision to predictive policy learning through an auxiliary DiT module and asymmetric attention.
The resulting policy improves average success on RoboTwin-Plus, LIBERO Plus, and four Franka tasks while preserving the FastWAM inference architecture.
The representation ablation supports retaining RGB observations and using structural prediction as complementary supervision; the gain is clearest under sensor noise.
blocks.zh:
HOG-WAM通过辅助的DiT模块和不对称的注意,为预测性政策学习增加了决定未来的监督.
由此产生的政策提高了RoboTwin-Plus,LIBERO Plus,以及四个Franka任务的平均成功率,同时保留了FastWAM推论架构.
表示衰减支持保留RGB观测,并使用结构预测作为辅助监督;在传感器噪声下收益最明显.

The RoboTwin collection contains 27,500 demonstrations from 50 tasks: 50 clean and 500 randomized demonstrations per task.
Both policies use the same trajectory-level split of 27,225 training and 275 validation demonstrations and eight independently noised action copies per visual sample.
Training uses AdamW with peak learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 2 10^{-2} , and effective batch size 1,024 for five epochs; evaluation uses the final step-29,365 checkpoints.
The learning rate warms up for 1,468 steps and then decays by a cosine schedule to 10 − 6 10^{-6} .
The optimizer uses ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.95) , ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} , and gradient-norm clipping at 1. Section B.1 summarizes the benchmark-specific settings.
For LIBERO, FastWAM and HOG-WAM use the same 40-task, 2,000-demonstration collection, normalization statistics, effective batch size of 256, and action-copy count τ = 8 \tau=8 .
Training uses a peak learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay of 10 − 2 10^{-2} , and ten epochs.
We evaluate the final checkpoints at step 13,200.
The models with visual and action DiT modules assign unit weights to their visual and action objectives; HOG-WAM additionally assigns unit weight to its HOG objective.
The auxiliary HOG DiT module increases training computation and parameter count.

blocks.en: B.3 Evaluation sampling and action prediction
blocks.zh: B.3 评价抽样和行动预测

blocks.en:
For RoboTwin, each completed model–condition evaluation contains 100 valid episodes for each of 50 tasks.
Episodes interrupted by simulation errors are excluded from the success-rate denominator.
Initial scenes are selected by the benchmark’s expert-solvability criterion.
The comparisons use the same task populations and episode budgets.
The expert-solvability criterion can yield different scene seeds across policies, so initial scenes are unpaired.

专家的可解性标准可以在政策上产生不同的场景种子,所以最初的场景是不被夸大.

Both policies are evaluated in all six conditions with these episode budgets.

blocks.en: B.4 Additional π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} baseline

We evaluate the publicly released motus-robotics/pi0.5_robotwin2 model [ 4 , 24 ] , using the weights at training step 40,000 and normalization statistics for the combined clean and randomized training data.
The policy receives measured joint positions, predicts 32 actions with ten denoising steps, and executes all 32 before obtaining the next observation.
This measured-joint-state protocol defines our reproduction setting, with a longer execution horizon than the 24 actions used by FastWAM and HOG-WAM.
The release metadata describes constructing states from actions; the source for that preprocessing is unavailable.
blocks.zh:
我们评估公开发布的motus-robotics/pi0.5_robotwin2模型[4,24],利用培训阶段的权重40,000和规范化统计数据来评估综合的清洁和随机培训数据.
该政策得到衡量的共同立场,预测有32项行动,有10个取消提名的步骤,并在获得下一次观察之前执行全部32项。
这个被测量的-联合状态协议定义了我们的复制设置,执行范围比FastWAM和HOG-WAM使用的24个动作要长.
发布元数据描述从动作构建状态;该预处理的源不可用.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the publicly released motus-robotics/Motus_robotwin2 model [ 3 , 23 ] at training step 40,000.
The policy receives three RGB camera views, language instructions, and measured joint positions, and uses the released action-normalization statistics.
It predicts and executes 16 actions per observation with ten denoising steps.
The evaluation covers the same six conditions, with 100 valid episodes for each of the 50 tasks per condition.

blocks.en: B.7 Uncertainty across source tasks
blocks.zh: B.7 各来源任务的不确定性

blocks.en:
The simulation comparisons use fixed trained checkpoints.
To assess sensitivity to task composition, we construct percentile intervals from 20,000 bootstrap resamples of source tasks, using random seed 20261117.
All outcomes belonging to a sampled task remain together, preserving dependencies among its perturbation variants and the policy comparison.
blocks.zh:
模拟比较使用训练有素的固定检查站。
为了评估对任务构成的敏感性,我们利用20261117号随机种子,从20 000个原始任务的靴子上,构建了百分位间隔。
属于抽样任务的所有成果仍然放在一起,维持其扰动变体和政策比较的依赖性。

blocks.en:
For LIBERO Plus, we verify the pairing of all 10,030 variants by suite, task identifier, instruction, initial-state seed, and action budget.
Within each of the four source suites, we sample ten base tasks with replacement and retain all variants of each selected task for both models.
We recalculate the pooled success-rate difference in each resample, so tasks contribute in proportion to their variant counts as in the reported benchmark score. Section B.7 reports the resulting pointwise 95% intervals.
The overall interval spans zero, whereas the sensor-noise interval is positive; the category analysis identifies where the gain is most consistent across source tasks.
These intervals describe task-sampling uncertainty conditional on the evaluated policies; repeated training and repeated rollouts of a fixed variant are separate sources of variation.
blocks.zh:
为利伯罗 此外,我们通过套房、任务标识、指示、初始状态种子和行动预算来验证所有10 030种变种的配对。
在4个源套房的每个套房中,我们以替换方式抽取了10个基础任务,并为两个模型保留了每个选定任务的所有变体.
我们重新计算每次复标的集合成功率差异,因此任务按照报告基准分数的变数按比例贡献. B.7节报告了由此得出的95%的间隔。
整体间隔为0个,而传感器-噪音间隔为正;类别分析确定不同源任务之间收益最相符合的地方.
这些间隔描述的是任务抽样的不确定性,以评价的政策为条件;重复培训和反复推出固定变体是不同的变异来源。

Each cluster retains the 100 episodes for its task and policy; initial scenes remain unpaired across policies.
The resampling therefore measures sensitivity to the task mix without imposing episode-level pairing.

blocks.en: C.3 Asymmetric attention and removable auxiliary supervision
blocks.zh: C.3. 不对称注意力和可移动辅助监督

blocks.en:
The attention diagram in the main paper depicts the visibility pattern at each coupled DiT layer.
RGB queries attend to RGB keys, and HOG queries attend to both RGB and HOG keys.
Both visual streams follow the first-frame-causal rule: observed-frame queries attend only to observed-frame keys, whereas future queries attend to the observed frame and all noisy future frames.
Future visual tokens can therefore interact in both temporal directions.
Action queries attend to observed RGB keys and to keys from the same action copy.
The mask isolates independently sampled action copies and excludes HOG features from action conditioning.

两个视觉流都遵循了第一帧-因果规则:被观测到的帧查询只处理被观测到的帧密钥,而未来的查询则处理被观测到的帧和所有吵闹的未来帧.
因此,未来的视觉符号可以在两个时间方向上相互作用.
动作查询处理所观察到的 RGB 密钥和同一动作副本的密钥.
口罩将独立抽取的动作副本隔离出,并将HOG特征排除在动作条件之外.

blocks.en:
The four Franka tasks span reorientation, containment, stacking, and insertion.
Reorientation requires the white plastic bracket to remain in the intended upside-down pose; placement requires the target produce to lie fully inside the basket.
Stacking requires the red block to rest stably on the blue block; insertion requires the cylinder to be seated in its circular holder.
The main paper shows four recorded demonstration frames in the upper row and their corresponding gradient visualizations in the lower row, with one task per column.
These monochrome displays use the same Sobel-based visualization as the method figures; the three-channel HOG target is defined in Sec. C.1 .

blocks.en:
The collection contains 407,143 frames from 1,000 demonstrations recorded at 30 Hz.
Produce placement contributes 400 demonstrations, and each other task contributes 200.
Observations include images from a main camera and a wrist camera.
The state comprises seven measured joint positions and the gripper width; each action comprises seven absolute joint targets in radians and a binary gripper command.
Training preserves this sampling rate.
FastWAM and HOG-WAM use the same trajectory-level split of 900 training and 100 validation demonstrations, with normalization statistics computed only from training trajectories.
Both models use an effective batch size of 128, τ = 8 \tau=8 , and a peak learning rate of 2.5 × 10 − 5 2.5\times 10^{-5} .
The learning rate uses a 300-step warmup and follows a 6,000-step cosine schedule through step 3,000.
It then decays continuously from that value to 2.5 × 10 − 7 2.5\times 10^{-7} at step 30,000.
Optimizer state is preserved across the schedule transition.
The physical evaluation uses the final step-30,000 checkpoint for each model.

The noisy condition applies the same mixed-noise operator as RoboTwin-Plus ( Appendix B ) to the composed RGB observation before visual encoding.
It combines additive Gaussian noise with standard deviation 10 in 8-bit intensity units and multiplicative speckle noise with standard deviation 0.05.
The resulting pixel values are rounded and clipped to [ 0,255 ] [0,255] .
Language and proprioceptive conditioning are unchanged.
Each task–model–condition group contains 25 recorded binary outcomes, giving 100 trials per model and condition and 400 trials overall.
Each trial has a maximum budget of 200 steps and ends early when the task succeeds or a failure/error occurs.
After each trial, the robot is reset using the reset command.
All 25 recorded outcomes enter the denominator of their corresponding group. Appendix D reports the success counts.
The macro-average assigns equal weight to the four tasks; because trial counts are equal, it also equals the pooled success rate within a model and condition.

blocks.en:
This study compares FastWAM, RGB-to-HOG, and HOG-WAM to distinguish auxiliary structural supervision from replacing RGB inputs and targets.
RGB-to-HOG retains the visual and action DiT modules of FastWAM and applies ℋ \mathcal{H} before visual encoding during both training and inference.
Its visual DiT predicts future HOG latents in place of future RGB latents.
All three configurations use the same 40-task, 2,000-demonstration LIBERO collection and normalization statistics.
They share an effective batch size of 256, action-copy count τ = 8 \tau=8 , peak learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay of 10 − 2 10^{-2} , and ten training epochs; all are evaluated at step 13,200.
FastWAM and RGB-to-HOG assign unit weights to their visual and action objectives; HOG-WAM additionally assigns unit weight to its HOG objective.
Each model uses the same 10,030 LIBERO Plus variants, instructions, first official initial states, random seeds, and action-step budgets.
Each policy predicts 32 actions with ten flow-integration steps and executes the first eight before replanning.
